subject.title: feat(loop): implement autonomous agent loop (/loop) with token budget guard

question: Should autonomous iterative execution extend the existing `/goal` control plane, become a separately owned core `/loop` system, or remain outside core?
rationale: The choice determines the permanent orchestration, session-state, permission, command-surface, and compatibility boundaries; those cannot be selected safely through mechanical PR repair.

options.title: Extend `/goal` narrowly
options.body: Use the existing goal lifecycle and token accounting, adding only approved verification or iteration capabilities through focused changes.

options.title: Sponsor a separate loop system
options.body: Define the cross-surface owner, SQLite schema, permission model, cancellation semantics, and upgrade contract before replacing this implementation.

options.title: Decline the core feature
options.body: Keep `/goal`, Task Flow, plugins, and external orchestration as the supported paths for autonomous multi-step work.

recommendation.title: Extend `/goal` narrowly
recommendation.body: Use the existing goal lifecycle and token accounting, adding only approved verification or iteration capabilities through focused changes.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision crosses core product scope, agent orchestration, session state, and public command behavior.
